text:
jessica: Heads-up — Acme Therapeutics flagged a renewal health risk. Usage is down ~40% q/q and they just returned our vendor questionnaire with a few blanks under 'data residency' and 'KMS key provenance'. I want to triage before it hits AM/AE.

dana: Yep saw that this morning. They also asked for SOC2 scope clarification — specifically whether embeddings storage is covered by our controls. Customer is worried about PHI in embeddings.

omar: Quick answers from security side: we consider embeddings stored in our managed store as within scope when the account opts into managed storage. For private deployments the customer-managed KMS + audit logs are required. I can paste the short proof we send to customers.

omar: Proof snippet: `We process and store embeddings within scoped systems under SOC2 controls. Customer-managed KMS can be used for Private deployment; for Hosted accounts we use CMK with restricted access. Audit logs retained 90 days by default.`

liam: From infra/eng: usage dip looks correlated with a client-side change — they started sending shorter contexts end of Jan. I looked at the token distribution: `mean_seq_length` fell from ~820 to ~210. That explains cost drop but also lower perceived value by product team.

jessica: Good call. So two tracks: (1) answer questionnaire (KMS + SOC2 scope + retention) and attach proof artifacts; (2) enable a short product enablement to show value on lower-cost prompts + best-practices.

omar: I'll attach the SOC2 excerpt and KMS attestation PDF in a moment. @evidence-bot please upload SOC2-excerpt.pdf and kms-attestation.pdf to the thread.

evidence-bot: Uploaded SOC2-excerpt.pdf and kms-attestation.pdf :white_check_mark:

dana: Thanks. I'll send the questionnaire back to Acme with those attachments and a short note about embeddings pseudonymization guidance.

jessica: Also proposing a 30-minute enablement session next Tue to run through prompt patterns + embedding hygiene. Will you handle scheduling, dana?

dana: Yep I can schedule. Who should present from eng? liam?

liam: Happy to run it. I can demo how to chunk contexts, reduce context size, and show reranking/recall patterns that preserve signal. Will prepare a 10-min notebook.

jessica: Perfect. One more ask: product health owner — can we add an early-warning label in Gainsight for accounts with >25% usage drop + opened vendor questionnaire? That would help automate reachouts.

omar: Agree. I'll add a note to the questionnaire response recommending BYOK or Private deployment for PHI-sensitive workloads.

jessica: Great. Action items: dana send questionnaire + attachments (due EOD today), liam prepare 10-min demo (due Mon EOD), jessica follow up on Gainsight rule (Tues). I'll update AE once session is scheduled. :thumbsup:

dana: On it.

liam: Will upload demo slides to the customer folder when ready.

jessica: Thanks team — lets keep this tight, want to avoid drift into renewal risk. :eyes:
